description: Source code for HpackEntryDecoder class, which handles decoding of HPACK header entries in HTTP/2, including state management and listener callbacks.

classes.name: NameDecoderListener
classes.description: Helper class converting string decoder calls for header name into listener callbacks.

classes.name: ValueDecoderListener
classes.description: Helper class converting string decoder calls for header value into listener callbacks.

methods.name: HpackEntryDecoder::Start
methods.description: Begins decoding a header entry from the buffer, invoking listener callbacks upon completion.

methods.name: HpackEntryDecoder::Resume
methods.description: Resumes decoding a header entry from a previous incomplete state.

methods.name: HpackEntryDecoder::DispatchOnType
methods.description: Dispatches header entry based on its type, invoking appropriate listener methods.

methods.name: HpackEntryDecoder::OutputDebugString
methods.description: Outputs a debug string representing the current state of the decoder.

methods.name: HpackEntryDecoder::DebugString
methods.description: Returns a string with debug information about the decoder.
